title: Out of Position
line: 누구 옆에 있든 상관없었어. 원래 제자리 같은 건 없었으니까.

title: After the Buzzer
line: 근데 불이 다 꺼지고 나면, 발은 늘 같은 문 앞에 가 있었어.

농담이나 던졌지, 신경 쓰이는 티 안 내고
Ask what he does, where he's from
뭐 하는 사람인지, 어디 사람인지 묻고
Like I care, like I'm just having fun
관심 있는 척, 그냥 재밌어서 묻는 척
You lean in close to see my phone
넌 내 폰 보겠다고 바짝 기대 오고
Then leave your jacket when you go
I used to think that was nothing
예전엔 그게 아무것도 아닌 줄 알았는데
Lose the one thing I've kept for years
몇 년을 지켜 온 단 하나를 잃고
Like I haven't changed my mind
So get out of my head
Funny how it's not that easy
At least that's what I've said

title: No Mercy
line: 빙판 위에선 봐주는 거 없어. 거기서만큼은 숨길 것도 없으니까.
lyr: Hear the blades against the ice
You can talk, you can take your time
I don’t need to hear the warning signs
경고 같은 건 안 들어도 돼
One step closer, watch your feet
한 발만 더 와 봐, 발밑 조심하고
You came here thinking you’d take the crown
Funny how things are looking now
근데 지금 꼴 좀 봐, 웃기지
I don’t give it up that easy
You want the crown, come take it
왕관 갖고 싶으면, 와서 뺏어 가
I don’t care how long it takes
Keep on coming, come and get me
You can try to hold me down
But I’m the last one standing now
끝까지 서 있는 건 결국 나야
또 한 번의 교대, 또 한 번의 기회
I don’t leave it in your hands
네 손에 맡겨 둘 생각 없어
You get close, I cut the lane
You won’t get that shot again
Hear the boards, feel the hit
펜스 울리는 소리, 몸으로 느껴 봐
That’s the price, get used to it
You can hate me when it’s done
I didn’t come here to be loved
I don’t give it up that easy
You want the crown, come take it
왕관 갖고 싶으면, 와서 뺏어 가
I don’t care how long it takes
Keep on coming, come and get me
You can try to hold me down
But I’m the last one standing now
끝까지 서 있는 건 결국 나야
Now give it all you’ve got
그럼 가진 거 다 걸어 봐
I don’t give it up that easy
You want the crown, come take it
왕관 갖고 싶으면, 와서 뺏어 가
I don’t care how long it takes
Keep on coming, come and get me
You can try to hold me down
But I’m the last one standing now
끝까지 서 있는 건 결국 나야

title: Stay Until the Blue Hour
line: 경기 끝난 새벽엔, 괜히 너를 태우고 먼 길로 돌아갔어.
lyr: Out past the road beyond the town
You fell asleep against the glass
I drove a little slower than I had to
난 괜히 조금 더 천천히 달렸어
Some song I didn’t really know
The sky was changing in the rearview
백미러 속 하늘이 색을 바꾸고 있었는데
And I didn’t want the night to move
난 이 밤이 지나가지 않길 바랐어
Don’t ask me where we’re going
I don’t think I want to know
Stay until the light comes through
I just like the view with you
그냥 너랑 보는 이 풍경이 좋아
Let the whole world come around
We can figure out the morning
When the sun comes up somehow
Your scarf is tangled in your coat
You say you’re cold, I turn the heat up
You laugh about the way I drive
넌 내 운전하는 꼴 보고 웃다가
Then close your eyes and fall asleep again
Maybe this is all it is
A quiet road, a little time
Nothing I would call a promise
Stay until the light comes through
I just like the view with you
그냥 너랑 보는 이 풍경이 좋아
Stay until the light comes through
I just like the view with you
그냥 너랑 보는 이 풍경이 좋아

title: Let the Morning Wait
line: 그러다 처음으로, 아침이 안 왔으면 좋겠다고 생각했어.
lyr: The night is nearly coming undone
Your hand is resting on my chest
네 손은 내 가슴 위에 얹혀 있고
For once, I don’t feel like moving yet
My phone is somewhere on the floor
I don’t remember what it’s for
The world can wait outside the door
가 봐야 할 데가 있긴 한데
But that’s not where I want to be
거긴 내가 있고 싶은 데가 아니야
We don’t have to go now
There’s no reason we should rush this time
I don’t usually stay this long
You’re probably right, I never will
네 말이 맞을 거야, 앞으로도 못 하겠지
But here I am, without a plan
근데 봐, 아무 계획 없이 여기 있잖아
With your fingers tangled in my hand
네 손가락이 내 손에 엉킨 채로
또 농담 하나 던질 수도 있어
Say something just to break the moment
이 순간 깨려고 아무 말이나 할 수도 있고
But I think I’ll let it be
You look better here beside me
내 옆에 있는 네가 더 좋아 보여
We don’t have to go now
There’s no reason we should rush this time
I don’t usually stay this long

line: 그런 밤이 아니면, 새벽 세 시 십칠 분엔 늘 혼자 깨어 있었어.
lyr: The street below is turning blue
The TV’s on but no one’s there
TV는 켜져 있는데 보는 사람은 없고
I’ve got too much time to spare
Your name comes up, I let it ring
네 이름이 뜨는데, 그냥 울리게 둬
I put the phone beside my bed
Then pick it up again instead
But there’s nowhere I need to go
근데 딱히 가야 할 데도 없어
I don’t remember what I came here for
A glass of water, maybe two
물 한 잔, 아니 두 잔쯤
Funny how I end up thinking of you
웃기지, 결국 또 네 생각이나 하고 있고
I’ve got nothing planned to say
할 말 같은 건 준비한 것도 없어
If you called me, I’d pick up

title: Cold Water
line: 놓아 버린 건 나였는데, 떠나지 못한 것도 나였어.
lyr: Woke up in the same old place
Guess I’m getting good at lying
Got your number in my phone
Still can’t bring myself to let it go
I could leave it all behind
But you’re always on my mind
And I know, I know, I know
I’m the one who let you go
널 놓아 버린 건 나라는 거
But every time the night gets colder
I just wanna pull you closer
You turn my whole world upside down
넌 내 세상을 통째로 뒤집어 놔
I keep falling, falling for you
난 자꾸 너한테 빠져, 또 빠져
I’m still here, I’m still here
난 아직 여기 있어, 여기 있어
Same old song, it sounds like you
I can dance until the morning light
아침 해가 뜰 때까지 춤출 수 있어도
But I never get you off my mind
Why I never let this feeling go
내가 왜 이 마음을 못 놓는지
I just laugh and turn away
And I know, I know, I know
I’m the one who let you go
널 놓아 버린 건 나라는 거
But every time the night gets colder
I just wanna pull you closer
You turn my whole world upside down
넌 내 세상을 통째로 뒤집어 놔
I keep falling, falling for you
난 자꾸 너한테 빠져, 또 빠져
I’m still here, I’m still here
난 아직 여기 있어, 여기 있어
Maybe I’m a little too far gone
Maybe I’ve been holding on too long
But if you ever turn around
You know where I’ll be found
Oh, you know where I’ll be found
You turn my whole world upside down
넌 내 세상을 통째로 뒤집어 놔
I keep falling, falling for you
난 자꾸 너한테 빠져, 또 빠져
I’m still here, I’m still here
난 아직 여기 있어, 여기 있어

title: No Reaction
line: 아무 반응도 하지 않는 게, 내가 아는 유일한 방어였어.
lyr: You got a lot to say tonight
Same old speech, a different lie
Keep your eyes on me, that’s fine
I’m somewhere else inside my mind
난 머릿속 다른 곳에 가 있으니까
You keep waiting for a sign
Like there’s something left to find
아직 찾을 게 남아 있는 것처럼
I could tell you what went wrong
뭐가 잘못됐는지 말해 줄 수도 있어
But we’d be here all night long
근데 그러면 밤새도록 여기 있어야 할걸
Go on, say it to my face
해 봐, 내 얼굴에 대고 말해
Funny how it sounds the same
There’s your picture on my phone
Strange, it looks like someone I
Used to know a long time before
Don’t know what I’m keeping it for
Say I’m colder than I’ve been
Maybe you’re not wrong this time
Maybe I just changed my mind
Go on, say it to my face
해 봐, 내 얼굴에 대고 말해
Funny how it sounds the same

title: Half Past Six
line: 그때의 우리는 서로를 사랑했지만 서로를 망가뜨렸어.
lyr: You were late again that evening
I was waiting by the stairs
You said traffic, I said nothing
넌 차가 막혔다 했고, 난 아무 말 안 했어
We were good at going nowhere
우린 어디로도 안 가는 데 선수였지
There was lipstick on your glass
You were looking at the ceiling
I was trying not to think
여섯 시 십오 분, 여섯 시 삼십 분
You said you’d only stay a while
We were laughing like we hadn’t fought
우린 싸운 적 없는 것처럼 웃고 있었어
And the room was turning blue
I was waiting for a reason
You were waiting for me to move
Like we always used to do
We were never good at leaving
We were worse at seeing through
You knew exactly where to hurt me
넌 날 어디를 찔러야 아픈지 정확히 알았고
I knew exactly what to say
난 무슨 말을 해야 하는지 정확히 알았지
We could turn a little silence
서로 증오할 무언가로 만들 수 있었어
You were sleeping in my T-shirt
I was lying through my teeth
Funny how we called it love
When we barely let each other breathe
서로 숨도 제대로 못 쉬게 해 놓고
여섯 시 십오 분, 여섯 시 삼십 분
You said you’d only stay a while
We were kissing like we’d won something
우린 뭐라도 이긴 것처럼 입을 맞추고 있었어
And the room was turning blue
I was waiting for a reason
You were waiting for me to move
Like we always used to do
We were never good at leaving
We were worse at seeing through
I don’t remember who started it
누가 먼저 시작했는지는 기억 안 나
And the room is empty now
There’s a clock above the doorway
I still know the way to you
난 아직도 너한테 가는 길을 알아
That’s the worst thing about it
I don’t have to think it through

title: Lighter
line: 담배는 끊었지만 네가 남긴 습관은 끊지 못했어.
lyr: I left the packet in the drawer
Still reach for it at half past four
그런데도 네 시 반이면 손이 가
There’s a mark upon the table
Where you used to leave your rings
But it doesn’t change a thing
I can stand here in the dark
난 어둠 속에 서 있을 수 있어
I just miss the little things
I quit the cigarettes in winter
When the air was turning thin
Didn’t know that all the silence
There’s a smell upon my collar
That I can’t quite wash away
Maybe it’s the smoke I’m missing
Still the same old stupid fingers
I can stand here in the dark
난 어둠 속에 서 있을 수 있어
I just miss the little things
I threw the last one out
I watched it hit the pavement
I just miss the little things

title: Ice
line: 뭔가 느껴질 줄 알았는데, 남은 건 얼음뿐이었어.
lyr: I took the long way home tonight
오늘 밤은 일부러 먼 길로 돌아왔어
Just to pass your old street
There’s a window with the curtains drawn
Where we used to sit and speak
I still remember how you laughed
When the rain came pouring down
Now I walk beneath the same grey sky
지금 난 똑같은 잿빛 하늘 아래를 걸어
And it’s strange how time can leave
꼭 필요한 것만 빼고 다 남겨 둬
And I’m still standing in the cold
난 아직도 추위 속에 서 있어
With a thousand things I never told you
너한테 끝내 하지 못한 수많은 말을 안고
All the words we used to know
Are getting harder to hold on to
I thought that I would feel something
A little hurt, a little hope
조금은 아프고, 조금은 바라게 될 줄
But all that’s left between us now
그런데 지금 우리 사이에 남은 건
I heard our song the other day
For a moment I was seventeen
And you were in my arms
But the feeling didn’t last too long
Funny how a place can hold a memory
웃기지, 장소는 기억을 붙잡고 있다는 게
And it’s strange how time can leave
꼭 필요한 것만 빼고 다 남겨 둬
And I’m still standing in the cold
난 아직도 추위 속에 서 있어
With a thousand things I never told you
너한테 끝내 하지 못한 수많은 말을 안고
All the words we used to know
Are getting harder to hold on to
I thought that I would feel something
A little hurt, a little hope
조금은 아프고, 조금은 바라게 될 줄
But all that’s left between us now
그런데 지금 우리 사이에 남은 건
Maybe we were just too young
Just to leave us wondering why
그저 이유를 궁금하게 만들려고 일어나는 걸지도
And if I saw you here again
Would I even know your face?
Or would we stand there like two strangers
아니면 우린 낯선 두 사람처럼 서 있을까
아무 할 말도 남지 않은 채로
And I’m still standing in the cold
난 아직도 추위 속에 서 있어
With a thousand things I never told you
너한테 끝내 하지 못한 수많은 말을 안고
All the words we used to know
Are getting harder to hold on to
I thought that I would feel something
A little hurt, a little hope
조금은 아프고, 조금은 바라게 될 줄
But all that’s left between us now
그런데 지금 우리 사이에 남은 건

title: Expensive Lessons
line: 많은 대가를 치렀다.
lyr: When you look at me like that
With that look upon your face
I move my hips, you lose your words
A little sound escapes your lips
네 입술 사이로 작은 소리가 새어 나와
You pull me closer by the shirt
And tell me not to stop like this
I like the way you say my name
네가 내 이름 부르는 게 좋아
As you pull me back again
The clock has lost its place
You bite down on your lower lip
I’ve got my hands around your waist
난 네 허리를 감싸 안고 있어
I like the way you say my name
네가 내 이름 부르는 게 좋아
I can hear it in your breathing
We both know what we’re doing
우리 둘 다 뭘 하는지 알잖아
I like the way you say my name
네가 내 이름 부르는 게 좋아

title: Useful
line: 아무에게도 바치지 않은 노래라고 말하지만, 사실은 네가 아니면 쓸 수 없는 노래야.
lyr: I learned to keep the curtains closed
To never ask the second question
두 번째 질문은 절대 하지 않는 법을
If the first one starts a fight
I learned to sleep beside the silence
I learned to leave the door unlocked
I learned a hundred useless things
All the damage that we did
All the things we couldn’t say
끝내 하지 못한 그 모든 말
All the ways we learned to live
우리가 버티는 법을 배운 그 모든 방식
All the nights we couldn’t sleep
I can write a thousand songs
노래는 천 곡도 쓸 수 있어
But there’s nothing left to keep
그런데 남겨 둘 건 아무것도 없어
I know exactly how you take your coffee
네가 커피를 어떻게 마시는지 정확히 알아
I know the sound before you lie
I know the look you get when leaving
떠날 때 네가 짓는 표정을 알아
And the way you never say goodbye
끝내 작별 인사는 안 하는 것도
I know the things I shouldn’t remember
I know the things I can’t forgive
Funny how I learned so much
웃기지, 그렇게 많은 걸 배웠다는 게
From the worst years that I lived
But don’t get the wrong idea
All the damage that we did
All the things we couldn’t say
끝내 하지 못한 그 모든 말
All the ways we learned to live
우리가 버티는 법을 배운 그 모든 방식
All the nights we couldn’t sleep
I can write a thousand songs
노래는 천 곡도 쓸 수 있어
But there’s nothing left to keep
그런데 남겨 둘 건 아무것도 없어
You taught me how to leave
I taught you how to stay
We just got good at walking away
All the damage that we did
All the things we couldn’t say
끝내 하지 못한 그 모든 말
All the ways we learned to live
우리가 버티는 법을 배운 그 모든 방식
Tell me, what was I to keep?
말해 봐, 난 뭘 붙잡았어야 했어?
I can write a thousand songs
노래는 천 곡도 쓸 수 있어
And still can’t put you to sleep
그래도 널 내 안에서 잠재우지 못해

title: Four Letters
line: 네 이름을 부르는 대신 연주로 남겼어.
lyr: There’s a room inside my head
Where the light never gets in
빛이 한 번도 들지 않는 곳
I have tried to lock the door
But it always lets you in
그런데 그 문은 늘 너를 들여보내
I don’t remember all the details
Just the colour of the walls
The way the silence filled the kitchen
The sound of footsteps in the hall
I can barely see your face now
이제 네 얼굴도 잘 안 보여
But I haven’t lost it yet
몇 년이 그렇게 사라질 수 있다는 게
Can bring you back in here
I have spent so long forgetting
I don’t know where to begin
Like a ghost beneath the floor
But they echo through the walls
I have met a thousand strangers
Sometimes one of them sounds familiar
And I hate it all the same
간직하고 있는 사진이 한 장 있어
Though the edges have turned grey
I don’t know why I haven’t thrown it
I just never found the day
그냥 그럴 날을 못 찾았을 뿐이야
몇 년이 그렇게 사라질 수 있다는 게
Can make the past feel near
I have spent so long forgetting
I don’t know where to begin
Like a ghost beneath the floor
But they echo through the walls
Maybe you were never really gone
어쩌면 넌 한 번도 떠난 적이 없고
Maybe I just learned to look away
어쩌면 나는 그저 눈 돌리는 법을 배운 거야
There’s a part of me that still remembers
내 안의 어떤 부분은 아직 기억해
Everything I never meant to say
하려던 게 아니었던 그 모든 말을
And if I ever hear it again
That name I buried years ago
몇 년 전에 묻어 둔 그 이름을
I wonder if I’ll turn around
All this time and all this distance
이 많은 시간과 이 먼 거리에도
And I never let them disappear
난 그걸 한 번도 지우지 않았어
They just learn to take up space
그냥 자리를 차지하는 법을 배울 뿐

title: For Blue
line: 차마 발매하지 못한 노래. 마스터 테이프 라벨에만 그의 손글씨로 For Blue라고 적혀 있었다.
note: 헤어지고 아직 얼마 안 된, 어린 모르페의 FOR BLUE 작곡 모습
lyr: The way you looked at mine
I thought I’d let it go
I thought I’d let it die
You’re waiting in the back of my mind
넌 내 머릿속 한구석에서 기다리고 있어
Like I’ve done a thousand times
But there’s something in the darkness
That still sounds like you tonight
내가 할 수 있는 건 없어
And if the night could take me
이 밤이 날 데려가 줄 수 있다면
Back to where we used to be
I’d stay there for a moment
If you’d stay there next to me
I barely hear the words now
It’s strange how time can change
But some things never leave you
Like a book upon a shelf
Like I’ve done a thousand times
But there’s something in the darkness
That still sounds like you tonight
내가 할 수 있는 건 없어
And if the night could take me
이 밤이 날 데려가 줄 수 있다면
Back to where we used to be
I’d stay there for a moment
If you’d stay there next to me

title: And you, and you, and you!
line: 아무도 아닌 사람에게 쓴 노래가, 매번 같은 사람에게 돌아간다. 이번 투어에서 처음 부른 곡이라 라이브 버전만 있다.
lyr: We had a room that let the rain come through
A second-hand couch and a broken fuse
Two young hearts with nothing to lose
잃을 것도 없던 어린 두 사람
You said we’d make it through
넌 우리가 버텨 낼 거라 했지
Camden nights and the Friday crowd
Cheap red wine and the music loud
You’d wait for me when the lights went down
Still laughing at my stupid mouth
내 철없는 말에 여전히 웃어 줬지
You knew my words, you knew my lies
넌 내 말도, 내 거짓말도 다 알았어
You saw right through my best disguise
We had the world ahead in view
And I had everything in you
I wrote this one for no one
이건 아무도 아닌 사람한테 쓴 노래
But it keeps coming back to you
And you, and you, and you
Like every little thing we knew
I changed the words, I changed the tune
I tried to make them something new
완전히 새로운 노래로 만들어 보려 했어
But every road, whatever I do
그런데 뭘 해도, 어느 길로 가도
Leads me back, leads me back to you
Leads me back, leads me back to you
Leads me back, leads me back to you
There’s someone sleeping next to me
지금 내 옆엔 잠든 사람이 있어
She makes it easy just to breathe
그 사람 곁에선 숨 쉬는 게 쉬워
She knows my songs, she knows my name
But somehow nothing sounds the same
그런데 왜인지 무엇도 그때처럼 들리지 않아
We’ve found our lives, we’ve moved along
우린 각자 살 길을 찾았고, 다 지나왔잖아
So why are you still in this song?
그런데 넌 왜 아직 이 노래 안에 있어?
I thought the years would pull us through
시간이 지나면 다 괜찮아질 줄 알았어
I’d find a way to make things new
새로 시작할 방법을 찾을 줄 알았어
But every time the music starts
I hear you somewhere in the dark
I wrote this one for no one
이건 아무도 아닌 사람한테 쓴 노래
But it keeps coming back to you
And you, and you, and you
Like every little thing we knew
I changed the words, I changed the tune
I tried to make them something new
완전히 새로운 노래로 만들어 보려 했어
But every road, whatever I do
그런데 뭘 해도, 어느 길로 가도
Leads me back, leads me back to you
Leads me back, leads me back to you
노래 한 곡 쓰는 거라는 게
I wrote this one for no one
이건 아무도 아닌 사람한테 쓴 노래
But it keeps coming back to you
And you, and you, and you
Like every little thing we knew
I changed the words, I changed the tune
I tried to make them something new
완전히 새로운 노래로 만들어 보려 했어
But every road, whatever I do
그런데 뭘 해도, 어느 길로 가도
Leads me back, leads me back to you
Leads me back, leads me back to you
And you, and you, and you!
And you, and you, and you!

title: Half Past Five
line: 여섯 시에 내가 뭘 할지 알면서, 다섯 시 반의 너를 붙잡고 있었어.
lyr: Sun’s coming low through the window
You’re humming something on the stairs
Two cups of tea going cold now
You’re asking what I want for dinner
넌 저녁에 뭐 먹고 싶냐고 물어
Like there’s a dinner left to make
I’m smiling back like it’s a Tuesday
난 평범한 화요일인 것처럼 웃어 줘
And not the night that I will break
오늘이 내가 다 부숴 버릴 밤이 아닌 것처럼
I’ve been saying them all week
At six o’clock I’ll be a stranger
여섯 시가 되면 난 낯선 사람이 돼
But it’s not six yet, so I don’t speak
근데 아직 여섯 시가 아니니까, 아무 말도 안 해
If I could keep the clock from turning
I would never have to go
There’s a sweater on the chair now
I keep looking at your hands
Like I’m learning them by sight
I could tell you why I’m doing it
That my voice is doing harm
But you’d stay, I know you’d stay
근데 넌 남겠지, 분명 남을 거야
And I’d keep you in the dark
그럼 난 널 계속 어둠 속에 두게 돼
I’ve been saying them all week
At six o’clock I’ll be a stranger
여섯 시가 되면 난 낯선 사람이 돼
But it’s not six yet, so I don’t speak
근데 아직 여섯 시가 아니니까, 아무 말도 안 해
If I could keep the clock from turning
I would never have to go
In an hour it’ll be six
And the room will turn to blue
In an hour you’ll hate me
한 시간 뒤면 넌 날 미워할 거고
And I’ll let you, ’cause it’s true
난 그냥 둘 거야, 그게 맞으니까
So don’t look at me like that
Don’t make it harder than it is
Let me stay here in the golden part
이 금빛 시간에 날 조금만 더 둬
One more minute, one more kiss
일 분만 더, 한 번만 더
If I could keep the clock from turning
I would never have to go

title: Bad Behaviour
line: 착하게 굴지 마. 오늘 밤만큼은.
lyr: 네 눈이 내 눈을 온통 훑어
We both know how this ends
이게 어떻게 끝날지 우리 둘 다 알잖아
더 가까이 와, 착하게 굴지 마
You know exactly what you’ve done
네가 뭘 했는지 넌 정확히 알잖아
Pull me under, push me away
I like you better when you misbehave
넌 말 안 들을 때가 더 좋아
Make a mess, then do it again
다 어질러 놓고, 또 그래 봐
No, we don’t have to make it right
Just make it worth the night
Just make it worth the night
I’ve got nothing left to prove
우리가 갈 수 있는 곳이 있어

I like you better when you misbehave

You know exactly what you’ve done

Pull me under, push me away
I like you better when you misbehave
넌 말 안 들을 때가 더 좋아
No, we don’t have to make it right
Just make it worth the night

title: Withdrawal
line: 네가 하룻밤만 없어도, 손이 떨렸어. 아무것도 모르던 열아홉, 월세로 녹음한 첫 곡.
lyr: You took the night bus to your mother’s
넌 야간 버스를 타고 엄마 집에 갔어
Said you’d only be a day
I’ve been pacing round the kitchen
Since the moment you went away
Rent’s due Friday, I don’t care
Spent it all on studio time
Wrote you seven different love songs
너한테 바치는 사랑 노래를 일곱 곡이나 썼는데
내 건 한 곡도 못 끝냈어
And my hands won’t stay still
And the walls are too loud
Come back home, come back home
Every night that you’re not here
I’m shaking like it’s been a year
I don’t need a needle, darling
I just need you in my bed
그냥 내 침대에 네가 있으면 돼
You’re the only thing I’ve ever read
Jude just turns the amp up loud
Kit says, mate, it’s been a day
Like that’s supposed to make it count
There’s your lipstick on the window
There’s your hair tie on my wrist
고칠 수 없는 뭔가가 돼 버렸어
And my hands won’t stay still
And the walls are too loud
Come back home, come back home
Every night that you’re not here
I’m shaking like it’s been a year
I don’t need a needle, darling
I just need you in my bed

Maybe this is how it starts
Maybe this is how it ends

I don’t need a needle, darling
I just need you in my bed
